meta.name: sculpture-3d
meta.description: Three-dimensional art and sculptural thinking for art education. Covers additive and subtractive sculptural processes, armature construction, modeling in clay, carving principles, casting and moldmaking, assemblage and found-object sculpture, installation art as expanded sculpture, and the conceptual transition from pictorial to spatial thinking. Use when working with three-dimensional media, analyzing sculptural form, understanding spatial composition, or investigating the relationship between sculpture and site.

copy.tagline: 探索三维艺术与雕塑思维，掌握空间造型技法。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在艺术教育或创作中理解三维形态与空间构成。
